name: DLSU Gokongwei Hall Study Area
description: A well-lit, air-conditioned study hall on the ground floor of Gokongwei Hall, popular among engineering students. Multiple power outlets and Wi-Fi access available.

name: Yuchengco Hall Benches
description: Shaded benches located outside Yuchengco Hall, offering a breezy spot to rest between classes. A common meeting point for students.

name: Henry Sy Sr. Hall Grounds
description: An open grassy area in front of the Henry Sy Sr. Hall, perfect for frisbee, picnics, or outdoor group activities. Very popular during university events.

name: Agno Food Court
description: A bustling food court offering a wide variety of affordable meals. Known for its lively atmosphere, especially during lunch hours.

name: DLSU Library 6th Floor
description: The 'Geek Floor' of the library. A designated quiet zone for individual study. Great view of the city.

name: Amphitheater
description: An open-air amphitheater used for performances, student gatherings, and as a general hangout spot.

name: Manila Zoo and Botanical Garden
description: A newly renovated zoological and botanical garden. A great place for a weekend stroll to see diverse flora and fauna.

name: Rizal Memorial Sports Complex
description: A national sports complex with a track oval, swimming pool, and various courts. Open to the public for jogging and other activities.

name: CCP Complex Grounds
description: Wide-open grounds facing Manila Bay, perfect for watching the sunset, biking, or having a picnic. Very popular in the late afternoons.

name: Paco Park
description: A historic circular park that was once a municipal cemetery. Now a serene and quiet spot for reflection and relaxation.

name: National Museum of Natural History
description: Explore the rich biodiversity of the Philippines. The central courtyard is a great place to sit and sketch.

name: UP Manila Library
description: A quiet and conducive environment for studying, open to students and researchers.

name: Baywalk
description: A popular promenade along Manila Bay, offering stunning sunset views and a variety of street food.

name: Robinsons Place Manila
description: A large shopping mall with a wide variety of shops, restaurants, and entertainment options.

name: Philippine General Hospital Park
description: A small park within the PGH compound, offering a quiet respite for patients, visitors, and staff.

name: Malate Church
description: A historic church with a peaceful courtyard, providing a quiet space for contemplation.

name: Cartimar Market
description: A well-known market for pets, plants, and biking equipment. A unique and bustling atmosphere.

name: Legazpi Active Park
description: A popular park in Makati with a jogging path, playground, and plenty of green space.

name: Ayala Triangle Gardens
description: A landscaped urban park in the heart of the Makati CBD, perfect for a lunch break or an evening stroll.

name: Greenbelt Chapel
description: A beautiful chapel surrounded by a pond and lush greenery, offering a tranquil escape within the Greenbelt mall complex.
